sections.title: What separates a serious AI development company from the rest
sections.description: The AI services market has two failure modes that ClickMasters is designed to avoid.

blocks.heading: General software agencies that 'do AI'
paragraphs: Agencies whose core capability is web development, mobile apps, or enterprise software that have added AI as a service line when client demand emerged. Their AI work is typically limited to connecting commercial APIs — important work, but not the same as building custom ML models, designing RAG architectures, or training computer vision systems. ClickMasters is exclusively an AI development company; there is no general software practice the AI work is adjacent to.

blocks.heading: Offshore AI shops offering unrealistic prices
paragraphs: Offshore quotes of $5,000–$15,000 for 'custom AI' are real — and frequently deliver projects with poor accuracy, no monitoring infrastructure, inadequate testing on real-world data, and no ongoing support. The apparent savings become costs when the project requires rebuild. ClickMasters builds with the same rigor North American enterprises apply to mission-critical software.

sections.title: Our engagement model
sections.description: Transparent, fixed-price, and accountable — no surprises, no hidden costs, no scope creep.

blocks.heading: Discovery First, Always
paragraphs: Every ClickMasters project begins with a paid Discovery phase ($5,000–$15,000) that assesses data availability, defines success metrics, and produces a fixed-price project specification. No surprises.

blocks.heading: Fixed-Price Contracts
paragraphs: Scoped projects are delivered at a fixed price agreed during Discovery. Time-and-materials is available for R&D-stage work where scope genuinely can't be pre-defined.

blocks.heading: Full IP Transfer
paragraphs: All model weights, code, pipelines, and documentation transfer to you on final payment. ClickMasters retains no license or access rights.

blocks.heading: Direct Access to Senior Engineers
paragraphs: No junior developers handed AI work that requires specialist judgment. Every ClickMasters engagement is staffed by experienced ML engineers and LLM architects.

sections.title: The questions serious buyers ask before choosing an AI development company
sections.description: No vague promises and no hidden discovery call required to understand the fundamentals.

items.objection: Why should we work with ClickMasters over a larger AI consultancy?
items.answer: Larger consultancies route AI engagements to junior teams applying templated playbooks at rates that reflect their brand premium. ClickMasters staffs senior ML engineers on every engagement, works transparently on pricing, and is accountable to production accuracy rather than deliverable checkboxes.

Yes — ClickMasters Artificial Intelligence Company is a US company. Primary team and technical leadership are US-based; project management, communication, and accountability operate on US business hours.

items.objection: What if the project doesn't go as planned?
items.answer: ClickMasters defines specific, measurable accuracy and delivery thresholds during Discovery — tied to your business requirements. If thresholds are missed due to our error, we remediate within the fixed price. If data problems discovered during development change the scope, we re-scope with client agreement before proceeding.

items.objection: Can you handle our industry's specific compliance requirements?
items.answer: Regulated industry compliance is a stated competency — SR 26-2, HIPAA, FCRA, EU AI Act, and NYC Local Law 144 are all specifically addressed in our project methodology.

sections.title: Questions about working with ClickMasters
sections.description: Clear answers about engagement, timelines, and fit.

items.question: What size companies does ClickMasters typically work with?
items.answer: Mid-market enterprises ($10M–$500M revenue) and growth-stage technology companies are ClickMasters' primary market, alongside enterprise divisions of larger organizations running focused AI development projects.

items.question: How long does a custom AI project take?
items.answer: 6–40 weeks depending on scope. Simple integrations: 6–12 weeks. Custom ML models: 10–20 weeks. Enterprise AI platforms: 24–40 weeks.

items.question: Does ClickMasters work with startups?
items.answer: Yes — for well-funded seed and Series A/B startups building AI-first products. Minimum project size is $20,000.

items.question: Can ClickMasters take over an AI project that's in trouble?
items.answer: Yes — project rescue engagements begin with an honest assessment of what's salvageable and what requires rebuild, before any remediation commitment.

items.question: Does ClickMasters work internationally?
items.answer: Primary markets are USA and Canada; ClickMasters also serves UK, Australian, and European clients with appropriate compliance context for each market.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Book a free consultation — we respond within 24 hours. After the initial call, if there's a fit, we scope and price a Discovery engagement, then the full project.

items.question: Do you offer fixed-price contracts?
items.answer: Yes — all scoped projects are delivered at a fixed price agreed during Discovery. No cost surprises from scope creep on defined requirements.

items.question: Who owns the intellectual property?
items.answer: You do. All model weights, code, pipelines, and documentation transfer to you on final payment. ClickMasters retains no license or access rights.
